component.name: Globtoo
component.summary: Explore Earth with an interactive 3D globe and projected maps

description.p: Globtoo is an interactive globe and map viewer built with SDL3 and OpenGL ES. Rotate the Earth, zoom into countries, and unfold the globe into flat maps using animated projections.
View English country names and borders, blend political colors with Earth imagery, display an adaptive geographic grid and distance scale, or mark locations using command-line coordinates.
